extension.description: Launch, stop, and manage Android Emulators and iOS Simulators in VS Code. Install APK/IPA apps, quick-start devices, and copy ADB serials or UDIDs.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Mobile Emulator Manager runs local Android SDK and Xcode command-line tools to list, start, stop, and install apps on emulators.
configuration.title: Mobile Emulator Manager
configuration.androidSdkPath.markdownDes: Path to the Android SDK. When empty, the extension uses `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, `ANDROID_HOME`, or the platform default SDK location.
configuration.xcodeDeveloperPath.markdow: Path to Xcode's Developer directory, for example `/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer`. When empty, the extension uses `xcode-select --print-path`.
configuration.androidEmulatorArgs.markdo: Additional Android Emulator command-line arguments. Enter one complete argument per item; they are appended after launch options selected in the extension.
